أنطلق (form VII)
# أَنْطَلِقُ (ʔanṭaliqu) /ʔan.tˤa.li.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْطَلَقَ (inṭalaqa)
# أَنْطَلِقَ (ʔanṭaliqa) /ʔan.tˤa.li.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَلَقَ (inṭalaqa)
# أَنْطَلِقْ (ʔanṭaliq) /ʔan.tˤa.liq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْطَلَقَ (inṭalaqa)
